title: Wayfare Partner Rate Card: Interior Package by Cleaning Level
content:
Partner rate card for Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning reports.

**Pricing rule.** A Wayfare partner detailer's work order on a cleaning fee report is priced at the price of its interior service, which is the rate card's standard interior package for the level held, rounded half up to the cent, and that price is recorded as the cleaning cost on file. A report with no partner work order on its evidence ledger has no partner price, and its cleaning cost on file is recorded as zero.

## Interior package by level held

| Fee level held | Standard interior package |
|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $45.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $85.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $140.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $210.00 |

## Inputs

- **Whether a partner work order is on file** — a cleaning receipt submission on the assessment's evidence ledger.
- **The level held** — the fee level on the assessment.

## Worked prices (hypothetical reports)

| Report | Partner work order on the evidence ledger | Price recorded as the cleaning cost on file |
|---|---|---|
| held at Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | one | $140.00 |
| held at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | one | $210.00 |
| held at Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | none | $0.00 — no partner price |

The package is read at the level the assessment holds when the price is recorded.
